Unit: N.I.C.E. Design Process  
Stage: Investigate & Inquire
:::

## Core idea

Research starts with a question, not a search box.

Our working sequence is:

**Ask → Search → Compare → Improve**

1. Use the needs already identified to form questions.
2. Find existing solutions.
3. Compare at least two.
4. Check how well each solution meets the actual needs and constraints.
5. Use the evidence to improve the next idea.

The point is not to collect links. The point is to learn something that changes or strengthens the design.

[Open the Inquiry slides](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1FoN2vg_Tmm2QAUfiJSqPqeSmV7y_m5Brknn0JXxKv0s/edit?usp=drivesdk)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Improve these notes

Add one good inquiry question and explain what evidence would help answer it. Add a comparison only if it changes the design decision.
:::
